jobs.occupation: Workplace / Occupational Safety Specialist (f/m/d) (Fachkraft - Arbeitssicherheit)
jobs.description: Workplace / Occupational Safety Specialist (f/m/d)- Operations Center Neuenburg 1- 80% - 100%- Supply Chain Management- EnglischAs Switzerland’s leading e-commerce platform, with a team of over 4'000 employees across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, we’re on our way to new markets. What drives us is the determination to constantly rethink the status quo. That’s why we’re looking for people who are passionate about truly making things better. With us, you’ll find the freedom and trust to take ownership, grow together with us, and stay true to yourself. Act galactic. Be You.As a trusted advisor to both employees and management, you drive safety awareness, lead trainings and audits, and implement impactful initiatives to prevent accidents and improve daily operations. If you bring strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and the ambition to grow into a leadership role, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.Deine Aufgaben- Taking responsibility for maintaining, sustaining, and further developing occupational health and safety, with possible expansion to a second location- Acting as the first point of contact and advisor for employees, stakeholders, authorities and management on all topics related to workplace safety- Promoting safety awareness and actively integrating occupational health and safety into daily operations- Planning and conducting internal trainings, briefings, audits and risk assessments, and supporting the operations teams in implementing and deriving measures- Ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements in occupational safety and health in collaboration with the relevant stakeholders and support functions (Company physician, fire safety officer (Brandschutzbeauftragter), etc.)- Independently implementing safety projects to improve workplace safety and prevent accidents on site- Supporting accident and near miss investigations, and deriving and implementing appropriate corrective measuresDeine Fähigkeiten- At least 3 years of experience in safety management or in a comparable role with interfaces to workplace / occupational safety- Preferable: Completed qualification as a Safety Specialist in German occupational safety: Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit / Sifa, ideally in a logistics environment- Very good English and German skills are required; French is an advantage- Analytical thinking and a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work come naturally to you- Strong communication skills combined with assertiveness- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectiveness- Expressing oneself truthfully and fostering genuine relationshipsWarum startest du bei uns?- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € and 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefitsDiversity is our culture.To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

jobs.occupation: Strategy Consultant (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: Ready to shape strategy where it matters? As a Strategy Consultant (f/m/d), you'll take on real responsibility from your first project - from concept to implementation across industries like Automotive & Batteries, Consumer Packaged Goods, Electronics & Semiconductor, Life Sciences and Power Utilities. Backed by Siemens technologies, you'll solve complex problems where strategy meets the real-world and make your mark both for our clients and within Siemens itself.What we offer you- Attractive remuneration package- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date- Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvementSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You'll make an impact by- Owning core project modules. Scoping the problem, running quantitative and qualitative analyses, and delivering recommendations your team and client can build on, with real responsibility from your very first project onward.** **- Building AI into the answer, not next to it. Treating agentic systems, industrial copilots, and applied analytics as core components of client demands. You apply critical thinking and human judgment to determine where AI creates measurable value and where it doesn’t, challenging outputs and validating assumptions rather than taking AI-generated answers at face value.- Working directly with decision-makers. Regular exchange with C-level executives and their teams, plus interviews and workshops that surface real disagreement instead of polite consensus.- **Seeing your work go live. **Because implementation sits under the same roof, your recommendations move from slide to pilot to rollout, across our industry units.- Shaping Siemens from within. Alongside client work, you take on transformation topics inside Siemens, a perspective on industrial transformation you won't get from client work alone.This is how you'll win us over- Consulting experience: Minimum two internships at a strategy consultancy, or first professional experience in the field.** **- Academic Excellence: Strong Master's, or MBA with a quantitative or technical core, or from a top business school.** **- AI in practice: AI is embedded in your daily work and problem-solving approach. You instinctively judge where technology creates real business value and where it doesn’t. Hands-on experience with agents, LLM applications, or data products is a big plus.** **- Global Mindset: International exposure gained through studies, internships, or work experience abroad.** **- Analytical skills: Ability to build defensible recommendations on incomplete data and explicitly state underlying assumptions.** **- Languages Proficiency: Fluent German (min. C1) and English (min. C1), both required. Many of our client discussions happen in German, so English alone is not sufficient for this role.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers.With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain.Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 people across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.
